{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kolto Trade League''' was the trading organization that controlled the flow of [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] off of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Like many [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] attack on Manaan in the [[Great Galactic War]], the Trade League was sympathetic towards the Republic's campaign against the Sith, and was impressed by the actions of the [[Barsen'thor]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Makeb]]. The League met with [[Tai Cordan]], president of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], to negotiate kolto rates following the resumption of hostilities during the Galactic War; after learning of the Balmorran's association with the Jedi Master, the Selkath's normally chilly attitude towards offworlders softened and his negotiations became more cordial.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=message|mail|President [[Tai Cordan]]}}</ref>
